$comment: Role registry. The authored source of truth for the ESPD role model: the buyer types that create a Request and the economic-operator roles that create a Response, each with its form behaviour (which Parts are visible/editable, and the mandatory/optional disposition of the four exclusion-ground categories) and its UBL party-role binding. Ported from the legacy espd-edm/roles.json and extended with exclusionCategoryMap (the Part III section-code -> exclusion-category prefix map that js/model.js currently hard-codes), so the whole role model is one first-class compiler input. The compiler (model/compiler/roles.mjs) validates this and emits model/generated/ui/roles.json; English label/description text is split out to the i18n catalogue, keyed role.label.<id> / role.description.<id>, mirroring the codelist service-data lens.

exclusionCategoryMap.$comment: Maps a Part III exclusion-ground section-code PREFIX to its exclusion category. Longest-match-independent: prefixes are mutually exclusive. 'exg-sitn' (conflicts of interest / distortion situations) rolls up to 'misconduct', matching the legacy EXCLUSION_CATEGORY_MAP in js/model.js.

buyerTypes.label: Contracting Authority
buyerTypes.description: A contracting authority subject to Directive 2014/24/EU creating an ESPD Request.

buyerTypes.label: Contracting Entity
buyerTypes.description: A contracting entity subject to Directive 2014/25/EU (utilities: water, energy, transport, postal services) creating an ESPD Request.

eoRoles.label: Sole tenderer
eoRoles.description: Economic operator which has submitted a tender without being part of a group of economic operators.

eoRoles.label: Group leader
eoRoles.description: Economic operator which is the leader of a group of economic operators.

eoRoles.label: Group member
eoRoles.description: Economic operator, which is a member of a group of economic operators, without being the leader.

eoRoles.label: Other entity (relied upon)
eoRoles.description: Economic operator (who is not a subcontractor) on which the tenderer relies upon, to meet selection criteria.

eoRoles.label: Subcontractor
eoRoles.description: Economic operator to whom the contractor assigns a share of the contract.
